title: Memory preserved outside startup locations
statement: Let $W$ be a word width, $F,N\in\bbn$ with $3\le F$, and let $m:\bbr\to\text{BitVec}(W)$ be a memory. The startup program initializes the constants at $-5,-7,-9$, the pool cells at addresses $-(25+4n)$ for $0\le n\le N$, the frame pointer at $-11$, and the frame cells at addresses $-2j$ for $4\le j<4+F$, also copying the two argument values into frame cells. After executing it, the resulting memory agrees with $m$ at every integer address outside the union of the constant and pool addresses, the frame-pointer address, and the frame-cell addresses.
